items.title: Has anyone built an autonomous AI operator for their side projects?
items.raw_excerpt: I spent the last month building what I call an AI operator - an autonomous agent that manages my side projects end-to-end while I focus on strategy. It runs on a 30-minute heartbeat loop, publishes daily blog posts, monitors Stripe for sales, checks sites are up, and does directory submissions. It knows when to escalate to me (financial decisions, strategic pivots) and when to just handle things. The hardest part was writing the decision tree - not the AI itself but defining what it owns vs. what needs human judgment. Current setup: main agent handles orchestration, a builder sub-agent handles code/deploys, an amplifier handles content/social. Revenue is small so far ($200 from PDFs) but the system works while I sleep. Curious if others have gone down this path and what broke for you.

items.title: PlateSpinner – A Kanban board that orchestrates AI coding agents
items.raw_excerpt: PlateSpinner is a local web app that manages AI coding agents through a kanban board. You point it at a project directory, describe what you want, and it spawns headless Claude Code / Codex / Gemini sessions to generate tasks, plan implementations, and write code. The workflow is: Propose → Plan → Execute. Generation and planning run in read-only mode. Execution gets full write access, creates branches, commits changes, and captures diffs for review. There's also an "autoclicker" mode where an AI judge continuously decides what to do next, propose, plan, or execute, so you can just watch. Built with React + Express + WebSocket. It doesn't call any cloud APIs directly — it shells out to the CLI tools the same way you would from a terminal.

At the beginning of 2023, we had already decided to focus on interactive 3D content. As the founder of VAST, Song Yachen recalled the origins of the startup with unwavering conviction. In his view, the slow adoption of 3D generation is not due to unclear technological paths, but because there has yet to be a true 3D UGC platform. This is why VAST chose to start with tools and models rather than waiting for a mature platform. In his opinion, while the platform format may not yet exist, the shift in content production methods is already clear.

When we met Song Yachen, he was having lunch at his office desk. An interview had just concluded that morning, and he took a brief break to eat before his next meeting in the afternoon. At the end of the month, he will fly to the U.S. to attend GDC (Game Developers Conference).

On March 5, 2026, the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground and the launch event for the industry's first physical AI data foundation platform, "Boundless," hosted by Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, concluded successfully at the Deqing International Conference Center. Themed "Boundless Expansion, Building the Future," the event brought together top experts and scholars in embodied intelligence, leading industry partners, representatives from renowned investment institutions, and government officials from provincial, municipal, district, and county levels. Through keynote speeches, product launches, technical sharing, roundtable discussions, and on-site visits, participants explored new pathways for breakthroughs in embodied intelligence data and its practical applications.  

As a globally leading provider of physical AI data foundations, Unquestionable Intelligence Technology showcased multiple core segments at the event, including guest speeches, core product launches, in-depth technical sharing, high-end roundtable forums, and on-site visits to the training ground. These segments comprehensively demonstrated the company's robust technical capabilities in embodied intelligence data, forward-looking industry strategies, and firm commitment to building an industrial ecosystem. Attendees also gained an immersive experience of the new possibilities in the development of the embodied intelligence industry.  

At the beginning of the event, relevant leaders from Deqing County delivered speeches, extending warm congratulations on the launch of the Boundless data foundation platform and expressing high recognition for the concept of the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground as an open, shared, and mutually beneficial industrial data infrastructure.  

Dr. Yu Kai, founder of Horizon Robotics and chief advisor of Unquestionable Intelligence Technology, delivered a keynote speech titled "High-Quality Data Drives Embodied Intelligence."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de marzo de 2026, el evento de lanzamiento del campo de entrenamiento para la recopilación de datos de inteligencia corpórea en el Delta del Yangtsé (Deqing) y la primera plataforma base de datos de IA física del sector, "Sin Límites", organizado por WuWen Intelligence, concluyó con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Conferencias de Deqing. Bajo el lema "Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro", la conferencia reunió a destacados expertos académicos, socios industriales líderes, representantes de reconocidas instituciones de inversión y autoridades gubernamentales de diversos niveles provinciales, municipales y locales. A través de discursos temáticos, presentaciones de productos, intercambios tecnológicos, mesas redondas y visitas in situ, se exploraron conjuntamente nuevas vías para superar los desafíos de los datos de inteligencia corpórea y su aplicación práctica. Imagen: Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro. Como proveedor líder mundial de bases de datos de IA física.

Recently, iCAR collaborated with Horizon Robotics to host the iCAR V27 & Horizon HSD Pioneer Experience Event. Leiphone's "New Auto Intelligence" was invited to experience the assisted driving capabilities of the iCAR V27, set to launch on March 13, in Beijing.

Flagship Computing Power + True Single-Stage End-to-End  
Before the actual vehicle experience, Horizon Robotics introduced the hardware and software configuration of the iCAR V27, as well as the development history of Horizon HSD.  

In terms of hardware, the iCAR V27 is equipped with the Horizon Journey 6P chip, offering a single-chip computing power of 560 TOPS, paired with 27 high-precision sensors (including LiDAR). The innovative storage and control systems significantly enhance data processing efficiency, reduce system latency, and enable continuous learning. Ample computing power redundancy reserves space for long-term OTA evolution of the vehicle.  

In terms of software, Horizon HSD adopts China's first mass-produced true single-stage end-to-end system. If traditional rule-based algorithms are likened to the mechanical splicing of different control modules, the single-stage end-to-end system achieves ultra-low latency from photon input to trajectory output. The system is 42% faster than the average human reaction time, enabling quicker responses to unexpected situations. The deeply coupled longitudinal and lateral control of the single-stage end-to-end system reduces undesirable behaviors such as light braking, hard braking, and "weaving" by over 90%, minimizing motion sickness. It also enhances the smoothness of lane changes, cornering, and obstacle avoidance.

items.title: Step 3.5 Flash 在海外杀疯了！“小龙虾”全球第一，阶跃星辰把开源卷到新高度
items.raw_excerpt: 昨日全面开源后，阶跃星辰新一代基座模型 Step 3.5 Flash 的全球热度进一步攀升，模型调用量在 OpenClaw （被网友称为“小龙虾”的全球知名开源项目）上已迅速攀升至全球第一。前五名中，紧随其后的是 MiniMax M2.5、Trinity Large Preview（free）、Kimi K2.5，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6——来自中国大模型创业公司的基座模型占据了过半席位。 有海外开发者认为，这款模型的开源力度在现阶段大模型市场中“十分罕见”，因为模型公司的惯常做法是开源成品模型（这样开发者能够做直接部署，但自由度不高）。而阶跃星辰算法团队不仅开源了 Step 3.5 Flash 模型，还开源了这款 Agent 基座模型的预训练权重（Base）、中训练权重（Midtrain）以及配套的 Steptron 训练框架。大模型训练过程中，预训练阶段主要解决模型的常识问题，让模型建立起对世界的基础认知；中训练阶段进一步强化模型高级专项能力，比如推理、代码、工具调用等，目前市场上 Agent 的能力差异也主要取决于中训练阶段的处理方式。阶跃星辰同时开源这两部分权重，意味着不仅支持开发者更灵活二次开发，更考虑到开发社区实际需求，为其提供更多元选项。结合开源的官方同款训练框架以及此前公开的技术报告，开发者能够以 Step 3.5 Flash 为基座，进行更极致创新与探索。 目前，阶跃星辰已在 GitHub 提供 OpenClaw 接入教程，详情请见  https://github.com/stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash/tree/main/cookbooks/openclaw。

excerpt_i18n.en: Following its full open-source release yesterday, the global popularity of Step 3.5 Flash, the new-generation base model from StepFun, has continued to rise. Its usage on OpenClaw (a globally renowned open-source project nicknamed "Crayfish" by netizens) has quickly climbed to the top worldwide. In the top five rankings, it is followed by MiniMax M2.5, Trinity Large Preview (free), Kimi K2.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6—with base models from Chinese AI startups occupying over half of the spots. Some overseas developers believe the extent of this model's open-source release is "quite rare" in the current large model market, as model companies typically open-source only finished models (which developers can deploy directly but with limited flexibility). In contrast, StepFun's algorithm team has not only open-sourced the Step 3.5 Flash model but also released the pre-training weights (Base), mid-training weights (Midtrain), and the accompanying Steptron training framework for this Agent base model. During large model training, the pre-training phase primarily addresses the model's common-sense issues, establishing its foundational understanding of the world. The mid-training phase further enhances the model's advanced specialized capabilities, such as reasoning, coding, and tool invocation. Currently, differences in Agent capabilities in the market largely depend on the handling of the mid-training phase. StepFun has open-sourced both sets of weights simultaneously.
